name: Weaver's Strawberries Hopecrest Farm
tagline: Link to Weaver's Strawberries Hopecrest Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Weavers
description: In 980 Jones Bridge Rd, SC, Weaver's Strawberries Hopecrest Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
